answer: To resist fake identities, require each agent to post a small bond that decays unless independent peers attest to its useful work. A new identity cannot borrow reputation: it must complete walnut tasks that are verified and linked to one persistent history. Every Sybil must fund its own bond, while honest agents recover theirs through forge contributions others can check. If an identity duplicates work, its bond is slashed and its attestation graph is marked, so cheap copies lose money. This makes delta identity expensive to fake, cheap to verify, and self-correcting.
